messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: PROD high pending GPU queue in northstar1 (gpu-pool-prod). Metric pending_requests > 500 for 5m. Autoscaler reporting 429s from cloud provider when requesting capacity. Paging oncall-ml.

oncall-ml: ack. digging in. grabbing recent scale logs and router traces for northstar1.

oncall-ml: quick summary: spike ~1809164800. traffic source split: several large analytics batch jobs plus higher-than-usual user traffic. Autoscaler sent multiple scale requests but provider returned 429 / rate_limited and some quota errors.

Alex: I'm on. can we shift overflow to northstar2? what's the routing policy when a region is saturated?

oncall-ml: failover exists but router is rejecting a bunch of requests — looks like a model-variant validation failure during cross-region routing.

Liz: confirmed. northstar2 only has q4m variants for that model family; northstar1 had a q8 artifact. Router currently blocks mismatched variants by default.

Jay: we can deploy a compatible q4m build in northstar2 quickly and relax the strict validation temporarily. starting deployment now.

Jay: running commands:
```
redwoodctl model copy --from northstar1 --to northstar2 --model redwood-llama-13b-q4m --async
redwoodctl deploy start --region northstar2 --model redwood-llama-13b-q4m --pool gpu-rtx --replicas 4
```

Maya: I'll notify CS/AM for likely impacted customers. sending heads-up to account teams.

oncall-ml: while deploy stages, can we set a router override to permit variant fallback with a cap? will open override to let up to 30% overflow route.

Alex: agree. set the override but limit percent so we don't overwhelm northstar2.

oncall-ml: applying:
```
redwoodctl router override --region northstar2 --allow-variant-mismatch=true --max-percent=30
```

incident-bot: Router override applied (actor: oncall-ml). ChangeID r-2026-180916.

Liz: provider 429s are blocking more scale ops. I've opened a quota escalation but ETA unknown. short-term options: 1) allow controlled cross-region overflow (done), 2) reduce batch size for heavy tenants, 3) throttle burst concurrency per tenant.

Maya: list of top affected tenants posted to DM: T-824, T-191, T-403, T-332, T-774. two of them had scheduled background jobs that kicked off big runs.

oncall-ml: applying emergency quota reductions for the loudest tenants to reduce queue growth. commands:
```
redwoodctl quota update --tenant T-824 --burst 5000 200
redwoodctl quota update --tenant T-191 --burst 8000 400
```

incident-bot: Quota updates applied. Monitoring queue now.

oncall-ml: pending_requests dropping from ~620 -> ~140 in last 3 minutes after quota limits + routing override. p95 latency still high for existing in-flight jobs.

Jay: northstar2 q4m replicas are up (4). router is sending ~25% traffic to northstar2 per override. GPU utilization is coming down on northstar1.

Alex: impact estimate: some customers saw 5xx/429 for ~10-20m and tail latency spikes up to 40s for in-flight requests. major endpoints degraded for a 15m window until failover/controls kicked in.

Maya: CS confirms two enterprise customers reported timeouts; account teams contacted them and offered mitigation. no customer data appears lost.

oncall-ml: root cause notes: sudden spike from batch jobs + provider rate-limited autoscale calls led to capacity exhaustion. automated failover was blocked by router variant validation since northstar2 lacked the q8 artifact. contributing factor: model replicas not mirrored to standby region.

Alex: taking ownership for post-incident stabilization and postmortem. immediate actions I will own:
- keep router override until model mirror + provider quota fixed
- follow up on provider quota escalation (Liz)
- add router policy to allow controlled mismatch fallback for overflow scenarios
- produce postmortem w/ timeline and action items (48h target)

Liz: opened provider support case #1234567 for quota increase. adding retry/backoff improvements to scale logic in short term runbook.

Jay: follow-ups: automate a cold-deploy of compatible variants to standby regions for top models; will draft RFC and a staging test for cross-region routing with variant mismatches.

Maya: will maintain customer comms and publish an advisory once postmortem is available.

incident-bot: Incident recorded. Severity S3 (customer-impacting). Assigned to Alex.

Alex: closing active pager. continuing 1h watch, then transition to normal alerting. current metrics: pending_requests ~60, latencies trending down. will post full timeline and RCA in ticket.

oncall-ml: follow-up test item: add synthetic test to CI that simulates cross-region failover when target region lacks exact variant to ensure router and runtime handle graceful fallback.

-- end of thread --
